plugins.//: The root package is a private workspace container, so @semantic-release/npm only bumps its version and never publishes. prepare: lockstep-bump @laugh-tale-island/core and @laugh-tale-island/react (react pins the exact core version it was tested against) and resync the lockfile — the workspace link satisfies react's core pin, so no registry fetch of the not-yet-published version happens. publish: build both packages, then publish core before react (react peers on core). Starter pins and eternal-pose versions are bumped deliberately per plugin release, never here.
plugins.publishCmd: npm run build:packages && npm publish -w packages/core --provenance --access public && npm publish -w packages/react --provenance --access public
